commands.text: uv run mypy sov_engine sov_transport sov_cli sov_daemon

uv run pytest tests/ -v \
  -W error::DeprecationWarning \
  -W error::PendingDeprecationWarning \
  -W "ignore::DeprecationWarning:websockets" \
  -W "ignore::DeprecationWarning:websockets.legacy" \
  -W "ignore::DeprecationWarning:uvicorn.protocols.websockets.websockets_impl"

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libssl-dev

cargo audit --deny warnings \
  --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0190 \
  --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0194 \
  --ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0195

# Build --ignore-vuln args from allowlist file if present.
ALLOWLIST_ARGS=""
if [ -f .pip-audit-ignore ]; then
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    # Strip trailing inline rationale comment + whitespace
    entry="${line%%#*}"
    entry="${entry// /}"
    entry="${entry//$'\t'/}"
    [ -z "$entry" ] && continue
    ALLOWLIST_ARGS="$ALLOWLIST_ARGS --ignore-vuln $entry"
  done < .pip-audit-ignore
fi
# Frozen lock → requirements.txt; uvx does not touch the project venv.
uv export --frozen --all-extras --no-hashes -o "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sov-reqs.txt"
# Overlay click==8.3.3 (PYSEC-2026-2132 / GHSA-47fr-3ffg-hgmw).
# uv.lock is shared across domains and must not be rewritten here;
# pyproject.toml is out of ci-tooling. Scanner env + exported reqs
# are pinned so this known click advisory cannot fail-open the rest
# of the gate; a real lock bump still belongs with the pyproject owner.
python3 -c "
from pathlib import Path
import os, re
p = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'sov-reqs.txt'
t = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
t2, n = re.subn(r'(?im)^click(?:==|>=|~=|!=|<|>)[^\n]*', 'click==8.3.3', t)
if n == 0:
    t2 = t.rstrip() + '\nclick==8.3.3\n'
p.write_text(t2, encoding='utf-8')
print('pinned click==8.3.3 in pip-audit input (replacements=%d)' % n)
"
# pip-audit fails on any unfixed advisory by default; --strict is
# for signature verification (different concern) and conflicts with
# positional --ignore-vuln args. Allowlist is the failure-mode gate.
uvx --from "pip-audit==${PIP_AUDIT_VERSION}" --with "click==8.3.3" pip-audit -r "${RUNNER_TEMP}/sov-reqs.txt" $ALLOWLIST_ARGS

uv run sov --help
uv run sov self-check
uv run sov doctor
uv run python -c "import sov_daemon, starlette, uvicorn"
uv run sov daemon --help

commands.step: Fail unless a v* tag is targeted
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "$GIT_REF" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
  echo "ok: github.ref=$GIT_REF"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ "$TAG_INPUT" =~ ^v ]]; then
  echo "ok: inputs.tag=$TAG_INPUT"
  exit 0
fi
echo "::error::Release requires github.ref=refs/tags/v* or workflow_dispatch inputs.tag matching ^v (event=$EVENT_NAME ref=$GIT_REF tag='$TAG_INPUT'). Actions → Release → Run workflow on the default branch with a blank tag is not a recovery; pass tag=vX.Y.Z or dispatch from the tag ref with the same value."
exit 1

VERSION=$(python -c "import tomllib; print(tomllib.loads(open('pyproject.toml','rb').read().decode())['project']['version'])")
TAG="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
if [ "$VERSION" != "$TAG" ]; then
  echo "::error::pyproject.toml version $VERSION does not match git tag $TAG"
  exit 1
fi
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

commands.step: Smoke test built wheel in fresh venv
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
SMOKE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
# hatchling produces sovereignty_game-*.whl (PEP 503 underscore form);
# `|| true` defangs `set -euo pipefail` propagating ls's nonzero exit
# when the glob has no matches, so the defensive empty-WHEEL check
# below can actually run. v2.0.0 shipped with two glob patterns
# (underscore + hyphen) — the hyphen variant matched nothing and
# killed the script via set -e BEFORE the if check; v2.0.1 fixes that.
WHEEL=$(ls dist/sovereignty_game-*.whl 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$WHEEL" ]; then
  echo "::error::No built wheel found under dist/"
  ls -la dist/
  exit 1
fi
echo "Smoke-testing wheel: $WHEEL"
python -m venv "$SMOKE_DIR/venv"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$SMOKE_DIR/venv/bin/activate"
pip install --upgrade pip
# Install with both extras. [daemon] pulls starlette/uvicorn/httpx.
# hatch wheel packages are sov_engine/sov_transport/sov_cli —
# sov_daemon is not on the import path unless the extra's install
# layout actually exposes it. `sov daemon --help` is CLI wiring
# only (Typer never imports sov_daemon). Import-surface check is
# `python -c "import sov_daemon, starlette, uvicorn"` (F-f6699291).
pip install "${WHEEL}[xrpl,daemon]"
# 1. --version exits 0 with a non-empty version line
VERSION_OUT=$(sov --version)
echo "sov --version => $VERSION_OUT"
[ -n "$VERSION_OUT" ] || { echo "::error::sov --version produced empty output"; exit 1; }
# 2. --help exits 0 and mentions the binary name
HELP_OUT=$(sov --help)
echo "$HELP_OUT" | grep -q "sov" || { echo "::error::sov --help missing binary name"; exit 1; }
# 3. self-check JSON status must be ok or warn (not fail)
STATUS=$(sov self-check --json | jq -r .status)
echo "sov self-check --json status => $STATUS"
case "$STATUS" in
  ok|warn) echo "Smoke test passed." ;;
  *) echo "::error::sov self-check --json reported status=$STATUS (expected ok|warn)"; exit 1 ;;
esac
# 4. CLI wiring: daemon Typer subapp is registered (does NOT
# import sov_daemon / starlette / uvicorn).
sov daemon --help > /dev/null || { echo "::error::sov daemon --help failed — daemon CLI not wired"; exit 1; }
# 5. Import surface for the [daemon] extra (F-f6699291). Typer
# --help never runs _import_daemon_api(); missing extra deps or a
# wheel that omitted sov_daemon must fail here.
python -c "import sov_daemon, starlette, uvicorn" || { echo "::error::[daemon] extra import surface missing (sov_daemon/starlette/uvicorn)"; exit 1; }
deactivate
rm -rf "$SMOKE_DIR"

VERSION=${RELEASE_TAG#v}
uv run pyinstaller --onefile --name "sovereignty" --console \
  --collect-submodules rich \
  --collect-data xrpl \
  sov_cli/__main__.py
OUTNAME="sovereignty-${VERSION}-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
mv "dist/sovereignty${{ matrix.ext }}" "dist/${OUTNAME}"
echo "ASSET_NAME=${OUTNAME}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y \
  libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libssl-dev \
  file patchelf libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev
sudo apt-get install -y libfuse2t64 || sudo apt-get install -y libfuse2

set -euo pipefail
if [ "${{ matrix.os }}" = "ubuntu-latest" ]; then
  if ! npm --prefix app run tauri build -- ${{ matrix.tauri-args }} --verbose; then
    echo "::warning::combined --bundles deb,appimage failed (likely linuxdeploy); rebuilding .deb only"
    find app/src-tauri/target -type f \
      \( -iname '*linuxdeploy*' -o -iname '*appimage*.log' \) \
      -print -exec echo '===== {} =====' \; -exec cat {} \; || true
    npm --prefix app run tauri build -- --bundles deb --verbose
  fi
else
  npm --prefix app run tauri build -- ${{ matrix.tauri-args }}
fi

set -euo pipefail
VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
export VERSION ARTIFACT_GLOBS BUNDLE_BASE TARGET
bash .github/scripts/stage-tauri-artifacts.sh

set -euo pipefail
VERSION=${RELEASE_TAG#v}
cd artifacts
sha256sum * > "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"
cat "checksums-${VERSION}.txt"

set -euo pipefail
export VERSION="${VERSION#v}"
python3 .github/scripts/generate-latest-json.py artifacts

set -euo pipefail
VERSION=${RELEASE_TAG#v}
cd artifacts
sha256sum * > "checksums-app-${VERSION}.txt"
cat "checksums-app-${VERSION}.txt"
